# Jotform Trigger

## Summary

Learn how to use the Jotform Trigger node in n8n.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/trigger-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.jotformtrigger.md

---

Learn how to use the Jotform Trigger node in n8n. Follow technical documentation to integrate Jotform Trigger node into your workflows.

[Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/) is an online form building service. Jotform's software creates forms with a drag and drop creation tool and an option to encrypt user data.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Credentials**

Refer to the [Jotform credentials documentation](/integrations/builtin/credentials/jotform) for authentication information for this node.
{% endhint %}

{% hint style="info" %}
**Examples and templates**

For usage examples and templates to help you get started, refer to n8n's [Jotform Trigger integrations](https://n8n.io/integrations/jotform-trigger/) page.
{% endhint %}
